text:
maria: quick heads-up, found a reproducible ordering glitch when a streaming connection idles ~4-6s and the gateway moves the lease. not resume token related, ordering at the merger gets confused.
ajay: can you share the trace id and repro steps?
maria: trace tr_edge_559 (link). repro: open streaming call, pause network ~5s, gateway hands off, client sees two partial chunks out of order.
charlie: are we using per-connection seq nums to order?
maria: yes. seqs reset on new lease -> different proxies emit the same seq space. downstream merge uses seq only.
lin: proposal: bind an epoch to the logical stream and include X-Stream-Epoch header. on lease transfer increment epoch. downstream order by (stream_id, epoch, seq).
ajay: needs changes in every proxy and the merge layer. we also need a handoff control message with last_ack_offset so the new proxy can know what to replay.
charlie: replay is dangerous for side-effecting messages (function/tool calls). default should be resume-only and disallow replay unless client marks stream safe.
maria: runtime can publish last_ack_offset during handoff. new proxy asks upstream: "accept replay from offset X?" upstream enforces policy based on side-effect flag and idempotency keys.
lin: alternative: block lease transfer until all outstanding frames ack. simpler correctness but increases eviction tail latency. tradeoff.
ajay: also consider a small jitter buffer at merge (50-200ms) to absorb minor reorders during epoch flip. latency vs correctness tradeoff.
charlie: observability: metrics for epoch_bumps, replay_requests, epoch_mismatch_drops, handoff_block_duration. console warning when a live stream gets an epoch bump.
maria: I'll draft an RFC with: epoch header sketch, handoff control proto (lease_id, stream_id, last_ack_offset, proposed_epoch, allow_replay), tradeoffs, repro trace, and opt-in replay policy. target RFC tomorrow AM.
lin: I'll prototype minimal gateway + merge changes in staging and run the repro across regions.
ajay: I'll add runtime hooks for last_ack_offset and an upstream replay accept API.
charlie: i'll review the RFC and check idempotency header extension impacts.
infra-bot: staging deploy queued: gateway candidate at 2026-03-21T15:42:00Z
maria: thanks all, filing draft and will ping the channel when it's up.
